title: Local SEO & Digital Marketing Podcast
author: John Sukowaty
description: Use these tips to keep your small business relevant against competition. Learn about local SEO, digital marketing, social media tips, email newsletters, website development, user interface tips, Google Business Profiles and so much more. My podcast is for the small business owner that wants to learn ways they can thrive in the digital world we all live in today! Stay tuned and let's chat!
